title: Woher stammt das Lied "Die Fahne hoch"?
original_title: Woher stammt das Lied "Die Fahne hoch"?
overview: Originally the marching song "The Flag on High," which had been part of Germany's national anthem, had an entirely different text. The song actually had its origins in a ballad: "A man wanted to ride home in order to visit his wife and child. That was the reason."
